 By BVM Sportsdesk, 10h ago UTSA offensive lineman Luke Lapeze is making the most of his final season after an injury sidelined him for all of 2024. Back in the starting role, he credits his teammates, coaches and medical staff for helping him return—and says the friendships he built in San Antonio have made the journey especially meaningful.
 By the Numbers Sixth year at UTSA
 Played all 14 games in 2022
 Missed the entire 2024 season with an injury
 10 games into his final campaign as of Nov. 14, 2026
 Yes, But Lapeze’s return followed a lengthy and difficult recovery; he said it took time to regain his footing after more than a year away from football. He’s grateful to be back on the field, whether starting or not.
 State of Play Lapeze has reclaimed a starting role in his final season.
 UTSA has two regular-season home games remaining.
 He points to the offensive line’s close bonds and the support of the training staff as key parts of his return.
 Bottom Line Lapeze’s comeback is a story of persistence—and of the people who make a team feel like family. As he closes out his UTSA career, he hopes the program and its fans know how much their support means.
